subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: What should count as meaningful session activity, and should the Sessions list derive that sort key at read time or persist a new projection?
rationale: The requested UX is valid, but event classification and parent rollup affect session state semantics and write load, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Derive At Read Time
options.body: Compute a bounded meaningful-activity projection from recent transcript/session events for list rows, avoiding parent-row rewrites from background churn.

options.title: Persist A Projection
options.body: Store `lastMeaningfulActivityAt` and reason metadata only with explicit qualifying write gates and upgrade tests for existing sessions.

options.title: Keep UpdatedAt Sort
options.body: Leave ordering as-is and limit work to adjacent preview or label polish, accepting that heartbeat/background noise may still affect ordering.

recommendation.title: Derive At Read Time
recommendation.body: Compute a bounded meaningful-activity projection from recent transcript/session events for list rows, avoiding parent-row rewrites from background churn.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for dashboard session API and session event semantics points to PR #50101 and follow-up commits by clay-datacurve.
